description: Read the scripts write_scripts writes, by the id it answered: status queued, in_progress, ready or failed. While it is queued or in_progress, call it again about once a minute; ready and failed are final. Ready answers each script by its number, with its shots and lines, the language its lines are in and what it left out of the description; failed answers why. quote_video and make_video take this id as script_id and a script's number as script. Free.
name: get_scripts
title: Scripts
